expected_diagnosis: Virtual disk grew, partition/filesystem remain smaller.
recommended_next_checks: lsblk -f; findmnt /; partition layout and free extents.
resolution_guidance: With backup/approval, use correct partition+filesystem grow procedure.
verification: lsblk and df show expected size and filesystem healthy.
production_warning: Không áp dụng lệnh chỉnh sửa trên VPS khách hàng khi chưa có quyền, backup và kế hoạch rollback.
